## Physical Security  
### Data Centers  
**Access Control:**
- Badge access only (biometric at main entrance)
- Visitor log maintained
- Escort required for non-staff
- CCTV monitoring (24/7)  
**Environmental Controls:**
- Fire suppression (sprinkler system)
- Power backup (generators, UPS)
- Climate control (temperature/humidity)
- Water detection (to prevent flooding)

raw_entities.description: A policy governing the physical security requirements for bank facilities, specifically focusing on the protection and environmental stability of data centers.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Badge and Biometric Access for Data Centers
raw_entities.description: Requirement that access to data centers is restricted to badge access only, with a specific mandate for biometric verification at the main entrance.
context: Badge access only (biometric at main entrance)

raw_entities.name: Visitor Logging and Escort Requirement
raw_entities.description: Obligation to maintain a log of all visitors and ensure that any non-staff personnel are escorted while within the data center.

raw_entities.name: Continuous CCTV Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Requirement for 24/7 CCTV monitoring to be active within the data center environment.

raw_entities.name: Environmental Safeguard Requirements
raw_entities.description: Mandate to implement fire suppression, power backup, climate control, and water detection systems to protect data center infrastructure.

raw_entities.name: Biometric Access Control
raw_entities.description: Technical control utilizing biometric verification at the main entrance to restrict unauthorized physical entry.

raw_entities.name: Visitor Log
raw_entities.description: Operational mechanism used to track and record the entry and exit of non-staff personnel.

raw_entities.name: CCTV Surveillance
raw_entities.description: Continuous 24/7 video monitoring used to detect and record physical security breaches.

raw_entities.name: Fire Suppression System
raw_entities.description: Technical safeguard consisting of a sprinkler system to mitigate the risk of fire in data centers.

raw_entities.name: Power Backup Systems
raw_entities.description: Redundant power mechanisms including generators and Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) to ensure continuous operation.

raw_entities.name: Climate Control System
raw_entities.description: Environmental control mechanism to regulate temperature and humidity within the data center.

raw_entities.name: Water Detection System
raw_entities.description: Monitoring tool designed to detect water ingress to prevent flooding of critical infrastructure.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Physical Access
raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorized individuals gaining entry to sensitive data center areas.

raw_entities.name: Environmental Hazard
raw_entities.description: Risks associated with fire, power failure, extreme temperature/humidity, or flooding within the data center.
